title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Bandhabi
desc: While trying to help Rama, Jayant is arrested for molestation, even though he is innocent. Unable to deal with his name being maligned, he turns into a smuggler and relocates to a remote area.

title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.

title: Mama Bhagne
desc: Raja, a lazy man, gets married to Payel under the assumption that she is from a wealthy family. However, he is shocked to learn that Payel's father is a gardener.

title: Ei Ghar Ei Sansar
desc: After their parents' demise, a woman puts her life on hold to tend to her brothers, but later experiences hardships and betrayals from backstabbing her family.

title: Dadar Kirti
desc: Kedar has loved Saraswati ever since he first set eyes on her. But just as Saraswati begins to warm up to him, Kedar's friends conspire to shatter his reputation.
